sources.entry: Google AI Pro for Students: Provides a free 1-year subscription to the Google AI Pro plan.

summary.name: Google AI for Students
summary.one_liner: Google's training hub for students on using Gemini and Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) for homework, exam prep, writing, and job search, plus details of a student offer for Google AI Pro.
use_cases: Turn class notes or lecture slides into practice quizzes
Create study guides from uploaded class material
Get prompting tips to use Gemini as a personal tutor
Get feedback on and tailor a resume for job applications
Explore career paths from life experience
Build practical AI skills through a certificate course
summary.what_it_does: The page is a set of training resources from Google's Grow with Google program for students. It offers short videos and guides on prompting Gemini for homework help, exam prep, and research. It describes uploading class material to Gemini Notebook to ask questions, generate study guides, and create audio overviews. Job-search content covers recruiter tips and using Gemini to give resume feedback. It also lists an AI Professional Certificate with 20+ hands-on activities and a Career Dreamer tool that uses AI to surface career skills and paths.
notable: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) turns uploaded class material into study guides, Q&A, and audio overviews
Career Dreamer uses AI to identify transferable skills and career paths
Free AI Professional Certificate with 20+ hands-on activities
caveats: The 12-month student Google AI Pro offer expired on October 6, 2025 and is no longer available in the listed region; only a 1-month trial is mentioned as an alternative.
Google AI Pro is a paid plan after any trial; the page says you will be charged the monthly rate if you do not cancel in time.
Users are told to follow their school's and professors' AI guidelines.
